alignment_check.note: This script never reads any precomputed *_va_nl_oof_*.npy file (grep-verified). Every VA_nl/VAT_nl OOF array is computed FRESH in-process, within run_arm()/fit_arm(), from V/A/y/groups/dense arrays that are constructed together (same function, same iteration order) for every cell -- so the 'bank item_ids order vs join/population order' landmine (mismatched precomputed OOF vs population row order) cannot occur here structurally.
